subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw add OptimizationGuide/WasmTts disabled-feature flags by default for managed and sandbox headless Chrome launches, or keep model-download suppression as an operator-controlled workaround?
rationale: The implementation surface is small, but current main already ships `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles and the default Chrome launch behavior affects all headless/server users, so maintainer intent and live Chrome proof are needed before changing defaults.

options.title: Prove, Then Add Headless Defaults
options.body: Run live current-Chrome proof and, if confirmed, add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused tests and docs.

options.title: Document Operator Control Only
options.body: Keep defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the supported mitigation.

options.title: Add A Dedicated Config Knob
options.body: Introduce a narrowly documented suppression option only if maintainers decide the existing `browser.extraArgs` surface is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Prove, Then Add Headless Defaults
recommendation.body: Run live current-Chrome proof and, if confirmed, add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the browser launcher ownership move and prior review guidance for this exact issue.
